name: my:Optima Secure follow-up dialogues v1 (practice set)
description: The conversations of the first memory evaluation (v3.3 development, condense_v1). Too easy to decide on: 11 of its 16 test follow-ups were answered correctly without memory. Kept as a practice set for trying changes; decisions use optima_secure_followups.json. Short conversations for evaluating conversation memory. Turn 1 is a test-set question; each later turn is a follow-up whose complete form is the test-set question named in 'item', so its answer key scores the answer. must_mention: alternatives the rewritten question must contain; must_not_mention: terms of the earlier topic it must not pull in.
